sourceTitle: Chaucer's Translation of Boethius's "De Consolatione Philosophiae"
description: "Chaucer's Translation of Boethius's 'De Consolatione Philosophiae'" is a philosophical text translated by Geoffrey Chaucer, written in the late 14th century. This work serves as Chaucer's English rendition of the seminal philosophical work by Boethius, exploring themes of fortune, happiness, and the nature of existence.
